verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਿ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਪੰਜ ਪੀਰ ਛਠਮੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j piaale pa(n)j peer chhaTham peer baiThaa gur bhaaree|

en.bdb: (From Guru Nanak to Guru Arjan Dev) Five pirs were there who drank from the five cups(of truth, contentment, compassion, dharama, discerning wisdom), and now the sixth great pir is holding the Guruship.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਰਜਨੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਲਟਿ ਕੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਵਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: arajan kaiaa palaT kai moorat harigobi(n)dh savaaree|

en.bdb: Arjan (Dev) transformed himself into Harigobind and sat majestically.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਲੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਸੋਢੀਆ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਣਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: chalee peeRee soddeeaa roop dhikhaavan vaaro vaaree|

en.bdb: Now the Sodhi lineage has started and they all will show their selves turn by turn.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਲਿ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਵਡ ਜੋਧਾ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhal bha(n)jan gur sooramaa vadd jodhaa bahu paraupakaaree|

en.bdb: This Guru, the vanquisher of armies, is very brave and benevolent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਨਿ ਸਿਖ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਛਿਅ ਮਹਲਾਂ ਤਕਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: puchhan sikh aradhaas kar chhia mahalaa(n) tak dharas nihaaree|

en.bdb: The Sikhs prayed and asked that they have seen the six Gurus (how many more are to come) .

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬੋਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: agam agochar satiguroo bole mukh te sunahu sa(n)saaree|

en.bdb: The true Guru, the knower of the unknowable and seer of the invisible told the Sikhs to listen to.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਸੋਢੀਆਂ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨੀਂਵ ਉਸਾਰਿ ਖਲਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug peeRee soddeeaa(n) nihachal nee(n)v usaar khalaaree|

en.bdb: The lineage of the Sodhis have been established on the sound foundation.
Four more Gurus will come to earth (yuga 2, yuga 2 i.e. 2+2=4)
